auth.eyebrow: Sign in to Vibes Paid Off
auth.intro: Use your GitHub or Google account. We only receive your name, email and profile photo, with no access to your repos or other data.
auth.note: By signing in, you agree to follow the Vibes Paid Off community rules.

errors.oauth: Could not reach the sign-in provider. Please try again.
errors.callback: Sign-in did not finish. Please try again.

onboarding.intro: Your username becomes your profile address and appears on every chat you show off.
onboarding.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
onboarding.unavailable: @{username} is not available. Try another one.
onboarding.invalid: Use 3–20 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
onboarding.displayNameHint: Your real name or a handle. Up to 60 characters.
onboarding.error: Could not save. Please try again.

me.soon: The full dashboard (my projects and profile editing) is coming soon. For now you can sign in and out.

media.hint: JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 3 images. The first one is the cover. You can also drop files here.

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again, then retry.
errors.forbidden: You cannot change the images of this project.
errors.invalid: Invalid request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.too_large: File too large. Up to 20 MB per image.
errors.unsupported_type: Format not supported. Use JPG, PNG, or WebP.
errors.not_found: The upload did not reach the server. Try again.
errors.invalid_image: This image cannot be read. Try another file.

projectCard.timeAfterSessions: {hours, number} {hours, plural, one {hour} other {hours}} and {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}} later

projectForm.submitLede: Answer a few questions, like a chat. An admin reviews your first project within 48 hours; after that, your projects go live right away.
projectForm.submitLedeTrusted: Answer a few questions, like a chat. You are a trusted maker, so your project goes live right away.
projectForm.editLede: Change anything, then save. Images are saved as soon as they are uploaded, removed, or moved.

status.pending: This project is waiting for admin review (within 48 hours).
status.rejected: An admin rejected this project: “{reason}”. Fix it, then save to send it back for review.
status.rejectedNoReason: An admin rejected this project. Fix it, then save to send it back for review.
status.hidden: This project is hidden because it was reported. An admin will look at it.

projectForm.draftRestored: Your last draft ({time}) is back. Images need to be picked again.

steps.prompt: Start with what matters most: what was the key prompt? It opens your project card.
steps.media: Send some screenshots. Up to 3, compressed automatically. A demo video works too.
steps.tools: Which tools did you use? Pick everything, from AI agents to hosting.
steps.sessions: Tell us about the build sessions. One session = one sitting. The total becomes “X hours later” on the card.
steps.lessons: Last one: what did you learn? You can skip it, but this is what people look for most.

rules.own: The project is yours, or you were directly involved in making it.
rules.illegal: No adult content, gambling, scams, phishing, or anything illegal.
rules.privacy: Do not show other people's personal data or API keys in screenshots and prompts.
rules.respect: Criticism is fine, belittling is not.

projectForm.descriptionPlaceholder: In short: who is it for, and what problem does it solve?

tools.suggestTitle: Add a tool that is not in the catalog

tools.hint: At least one AI tool (agent, app builder, or AI assistant).
